name: 맥치킨 모짜렐라

referenceVerification.method: Read official Korean menu description and visually inspected the rendered official product photo in the browser.
uncertainties: 공식 설명에서 골든 모짜렐라 치즈스틱 2개와 아라비아따 소스를 확인했다.
닭고기 부위·성형 여부는 이 상품 상세 설명만으로 확정하지 않았다.
치즈스틱 배치 및 흰색 소스는 공식 제품 사진의 관찰을 반영한 재현이다.

prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: an original generated burger product cutout for a Korean burger tournament.
Primary request: create one photorealistic Korean McDonald's McChicken Mozzarella, using the ingredient structure from the official photo and description viewed at https://www.mcdonalds.co.kr/kor/menu/detail/293/12/16. Create an original photograph, not the original official image.
Subject accuracy: EXACTLY ONE standard round breaded fried McChicken CHICKEN patty, fairly flat, golden-brown crunchy coating, plus EXACTLY TWO separate golden breaded oblong mozzarella CHEESE STICKS laid horizontally side-by-side above the chicken patty, unmistakably two cheese sticks, not a second chicken patty or round mozzarella patty. Slight white melted mozzarella visible between the two sticks as in the reference, no cheese pull stretching outside burger.
Official visible top-to-bottom stack: domed golden sesame-seed top bun; a little white mayonnaise; shredded pale-green iceberg lettuce; two golden mozzarella sticks forming their own horizontal layer; a thin red arrabbiata sauce layer; single round breaded chicken patty; a little white mayo at toasted bottom bun. No fresh tomato slices. No yellow American cheese, beef, bacon, pickles or onion rings.
Style: high quality realistic studio food product photography, bright neutral soft light, natural toasted bread and crunchy crumb textures, appetizing restrained color. Keep same clean cutout style as a fast-food burger product collection.
Composition: complete assembled burger centered on square canvas, nearly frontal slight three-quarter angle with top of bun visible, fills about 85% of width, all edges uncropped and clean transparent margin.
Scene/backdrop: real alpha transparency, no surface, no fake checkerboard.
Avoid: any text, logo, watermark, packaging, plate, fries, drink, props, hands, extra items, exploded diagram, cutaway burger.

validation.visualInspection: 패티 개수·주요 재료·층 순서·로고/텍스트 없음·전체 버거 구도를 검수했다. 배경 후광이나 바닥은 보이지 않는다.
validation.note: AI 재현 이미지이며 실제 상품의 두께·형상·질감과 완전히 동일함을 보장하지 않는다.
